summary: Prod API-key usage trace provisioning request for regulatory billing review
description:
Request summary:
Support has received a request from Finance/Compliance to run a correlated usage trace for one customer billing period (2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28) to validate API-key attribution across service boundaries. The goal is to reconcile billed tokens against ingress events when the customer asserts duplicate key usage from an internal integration.

Justification:
- Customer dispute escalated to Finance and Legal; compliance requires the ability to show the chain of custody for API-key based requests.
- Data needed is limited to metadata (timestamp, route, API key id, account id, request_id, responding model, token_count) and request hashes — not full request/response payloads.

Data scope and exclusions:
- Include: api_key_id, request_id, ingress_timestamp, route, model_served, token_count, response_status, upstream_ip (hashed), load-balancer request id.
- Exclude: full_request_payload, response_body, any free-text user content; do not include KV cache contents or raw output text.

Requested access window and retention:
- One-time extract for timeframe 2026-02-01 through 2026-02-28.
- Retention: data export must be retained no longer than 30 days post-provision unless further approved by Legal.

Controls requested by Compliance:
- Access via ephemeral, time-limited S3 presigned URL restricted to the Compliance and Finance group.
- Export must be encrypted with customer-managed KMS key.
- All actions logged and an audit trail published to the compliance channel.

Approvals required:
- Security (data minimization and KMS config)
- Privacy officer sign-off on exclusions and hashing approach
- Legal/Finance confirmation of scope

Operational ask for infra/SRE:
- Provide a provenance-preserving export pipeline that performs server-side redaction and hashing of IPs before writing to S3.
- Generate a manifest with counts per api_key_id and a checksum for validation.
- Provide a short runbook for how the extract was generated, with links to the query and the container/commit used.
investigation_notes:
2026-03-10: Triage - verified requestor is Finance (Marta Lopez) and Compliance approver (Anika Bose).
2026-03-10: Quick check of audit-log retention policies: prod audit-logs kept 90 days, but raw request bodies are redacted at ingest.
2026-03-11: Hypothesis: duplicate billing arose from two API keys mapped to the same billing account after an import; need to correlate api_key_id <-> account_id mapping in Auth DB.
2026-03-11: Ran a scoped query against request metadata index for timestamps in range; confirmed entries exist that show route path and token_count. Noted one ambiguous api_key_id that traces to a legacy migration key.
2026-03-12: Security provided proposed hashing scheme for upstream_ip and confirmed KMS envelope encryption is supported for one-off exports.
comments: Daniel Kim (Reporter) 2026-03-10: Filing the request on behalf of Finance. Attached initial Compliance checklist and overview.
Anika Bose (Compliance) 2026-03-10: Confirmed scope and agreed the export must exclude request/response body. Privacy to sign-off on hashing approach.
Priya Shah (Assignee/SRE) 2026-03-11: Will prepare a prototype extract using the audit-log SQL pipeline. Need Security to confirm KMS key ARN and IAM role to write to the presigned S3 bucket.

Ravi Patel (Security) 2026-03-11: Approved hashing for upstream_ip using HMAC-SHA256 with environment-specific salt. KMS key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01 will be used; provide IAM role name for write access.
Marta Lopez (Finance) 2026-03-12: Confirming that Finance reviewers will be two named personnel. Requesting manifest with per-key totals and checksums before download.
Anika Bose (Compliance) 2026-03-12: Privacy officer to review sample of 100 rows prior to full export. Please mask any UUIDs that appear to contain user-facing PII.
Priya Shah (SRE) 2026-03-12: Uploaded a proof-of-concept sample (100 rows) to secure review bucket; link provided in related_confluence_pages. Awaiting Privacy sign-off.
resolution_notes: Work in progress: PoC sample provided to Compliance/Privacy on 2026-03-12. Pending Privacy sign-off on sample and final KMS/IAM configuration before full extract. Planned mitigation: if Privacy rejects sample, halt export and propose further minimization (aggregate-only CSV by api_key_id). Follow-ups: create a small runbook for future one-off exports and add template to Confluence; post-approval, schedule a short retrospective with Finance/Compliance to decide whether a regular summarization report should be automated.
